maria_customer: Hey team — production tenant (acme-retail) reporting ~800ms extra latency and intermittent 401s since ~09:00 UTC. They’re on our Private VPC (us-west-2).

maria_customer: From their app logs it looks like outbound calls to api.redwood.internal are being routed to eu model pool (x-region: eu-west-1). They insist traffic should stay in us-west.

maria_customer: Repro steps: 1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate 2) check response headers and our app logs.

maria_customer: Example response header snippet: "x-redwood-region: eu-west-1" and remote_addr seen as 34.217.10.5 (their NAT).

jess_support: thanks — sorry about this. can you paste the curl output (headers + any x-forwarded-*) and the tenant id? also, did you notice any failover events in our console around 09:00?

maria_customer: tenant: acme-retail-prod. curl -I output below:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d


maria_customer: our app shows remote_ip 34.217.10.5 and we also see 401s when the call takes >1s.

dave_network: pinging in. @jess_support can you confirm whether the global routing policy fallback could map private egress IPs to EU pool? sounds like SNAT/hub proxy is rewriting to a pooled IP in EU.

jess_support: checking control plane events — there was a short health blip on the us-west NATTunnel at 08:58 UTC and automatic fallback to hub-proxy was triggered for some subnets. that would explain region header.

kai_oncall: looked at the ipfix from the hub — the SNAT pool used during failover belongs to the eu-hub (203.0.113.42). the route-map selected the hub path because our peered NAT had an intermediate health check flapping.

kai_oncall: impact: correct requests were proxied via eu-hub, causing increased p99 and occasional token verification failures because token audience validation is region-sensitive in some client setups.

dave_network: root cause hypothesis: when local NAT marks health down, route-map selects peering path but doesn’t preserve original source ASN/prefix. SNAT then maps to eu-hub pool -> region header eu-west-1. also some proxy code looks at src-ip to pick model region, so it picked eu.

jess_support: suggested mitigations: 1) short-term: add an override on the tenant private config to prefer egress_region: us-west-2 (affinity). 2) mid-term: update failover route-map to preserve source prefix or prefer local SNAT ranges per-tenant. 3) engineering follow-up to adjust proxy region-lookup to prefer explicit tenant / config tags over src-ip.

jess_support: CLI snippet to set tenant override (applies immediately):

curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/private/tenants/acme-retail-prod/egress-config \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"egress_region_preference": "us-west-2", "egress_fallback": "local-first"}'


maria_customer: applying override now, will report back in ~5m. thanks.

kai_oncall: additional repro for infra team: run tcpdump on the onprem gateway during failover and grep for 203.0.113.42 and 34.217.10.5 pairing. if you see SNAT mapping, route-map needs tweak.

logs-bot: Relevant control-plane event: "NATTunnel us-west-2/zt-321 flapped at 2026-02-12T08:58:32Z, fallback->hub-proxy eu-hub-1 applied to subnets: subnet-0a12, subnet-0a13"

logs-bot: Proxy log sample (anonymized):
[2026-02-12T08:59:01Z] src=34.217.10.5 dst=api.redwood.internal action=proxy SNAT=203.0.113.42 region_header=eu-west-1 duration_ms=912 token_check=failed-aud

jess_support: escalated to eng-networking and eng-runtime with INC-2026-1234. ENG: please triage route-map SNAT preservation and proxy region lookup precedence.

dave_network: quick config change we can ship: prefer-local-snat=true on route-map for private peering. will craft CL and target for a small rollout to onprem customers first. requires control-plane flag and no infra deploy.

kai_oncall: timeline: apply tenant override (done) -> observed decreased requests to eu-hub. if we flip prefer-local-snat, watch NAT health check timers; if local NAT is actually unhealthy, we should still fail but preserve source mapping (no EU SNAT).

maria_customer: override applied — latency back to normal (~60ms). 401s stopped. thanks for the quick help. :tada:

jess_support: great — keeping INC-2026-1234 open until eng fixes route-map. will update when change deploys.

deploy_bot: deploy scheduled: control-plane flag "prefer-local-snat" -> canary on 2026-02-13 02:00 UTC, rollout window 2h.

jess_support: any other logs you want from us, @maria_customer?

maria_customer: no, we’re good for now. please let us know once the route-map fix is live so we can remove the tenant override.

kai_oncall: noted. will post postmortem link in this thread after root cause and mitigation.

jess_support: thanks everyone.
